scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man tips a clay cup above a wooden tray holding nine pale stones and one reddish stone. Modestly robed neighbors watch around a stone table. Two elders stand inside an open limestone gateway, with homes beyond it and distant hill towns to the left, all painted in warm watercolor.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The lot-casting gathering illustrates the choice of one in ten to live in Jerusalem. One reddish pebble among nine pale ones makes that proportion visible; the elders inside the gate suggest the leaders already living there, while distant towns recall where the majority remained. The people, pebble method and architecture are imaginative details, not specified by the verse or claimed historical likenesses.
